passages.scripture: This Melchizedek was king of Salem and priest of God Most High. He met Abraham returning from the slaughter of the kings and blessed him, and Abraham apportioned to him a tenth of everything. First, his name means “king of righteousness.” Then also, “king of Salem” means “king of peace.”

lines.text: Melchizedek was king of the city of Salem.
“God Most High” is a name for God — God is higher than everyone and everything.
Melchizedek was a priest of God Most High.
Abraham had fought against several kings and defeated them.
As Abraham was returning from defeating the kings, Melchizedek met Abraham.
A tenth is one part out of every ten parts.
Abraham gave Melchizedek a tenth of everything.
The name Melchizedek means “king of righteousness” — king of what is right.

passages.scripture: Without father or mother or genealogy, without beginning of days or end of life, like the Son of God, he remains a priest for all time.

lines.text: A genealogy is a written list of a person’s ancestors — parents, grandparents, and so on.
Melchizedek is without father, without mother, without genealogy.
Genesis, the book of the Scriptures that tells about Melchizedek, does not name his father or mother or any of his ancestors.
Melchizedek has no beginning of days and no end of life.
Genesis does not tell when Melchizedek was born or when he died.
Melchizedek is made like the Son of God, who has no beginning and no end.
Melchizedek remains a priest for all time.
